title: What drove the increase
text: MD&A: higher spending on cruise ship fleet expansion, theme park and resort expansion and new attractions.

title: Disney Treasure, delivered November 2024
text: Sixth ship, 140,000 tons and 1,250 staterooms; $1.1B of the fixed-rate notes was borrowed against its delivery.
phrases: borrowed in connection with the November 2024 cruise ship delivery of the Disney Treasure

title: Disney Destiny and Disney Adventure, arriving fiscal 2026
text: Destiny: ~140,000 tons, 1,250 staterooms, sailing from November 20, 2025 in North America. Adventure: ~200,000 tons, ~2,100 staterooms, sailing from March 2026 in Southeast Asia.
phrases: In fiscal 2026, Disney Cruise Line will add two new ships, the Disney Destiny and the Disney Adventure

title: Four more ships under contract for 2027–2031
text: The pipeline behind continued cruise capex.
phrases: Between calendar years 2027 and 2031, Disney Cruise Line plans to launch four additional cruise ships, all of which are currently under contract to be built

title: Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point
text: Second private cruise destination, about 600 acres on Eleuthera.
phrases: Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point, which is located on approximately 600 acres of land on the island of Eleuthera

title: Tropical Americas at Disney’s Animal Kingdom, 2027
text: DinoLand USA is being rethemed; planned to open in 2027.
phrases: DinoLand USA will be rethemed and in 2027, is planned to open as Tropical Americas

title: Cruise-ship construction commitments
text: Contracted ship payments sit in the “Other” column with creative talent: $4,162M due in fiscal 2026, $12,321M in total.
phrases: The Company also has contractual commitments for the construction of cruise ships

title: FY2026 outlook: about $9B of capex
text: Higher spending at Experiences on theme park and resort expansion and new attractions, partly offset by lower cruise-ship spending as the current ships are delivered.
phrases: expects its fiscal 2026 capital expenditures to total approximately $9 billion
